cau_chuyen_en: Ben Thanh Market is a central market in Ho Chi Minh City. Its official market rules set regular hours at 07:00 to 22:00 and food sellers from 04:00.
nhin_ky_vi: Hãy nhìn tháp đồng hồ ở mặt tiền phía nam.
nhin_ky_en: Look for the clock tower above the south entrance.

cau_chuyen_en: Independence Palace is a preserved historical site. Its official visitor page lists daily visiting hours from 07:00 to 18:00.
nhin_ky_vi: Hãy quan sát cổng và các phòng được bảo tồn.
nhin_ky_en: Look at the entrance gates and preserved rooms.

cau_chuyen_en: Saigon Central Post Office is a working post office in the city centre. Vietnam Tourism lists its visitor hours as 07:30–12:00 and 13:30–17:00 daily.
nhin_ky_vi: Hãy nhìn mái vòm bên trong và những bản đồ cổ trên tường.
nhin_ky_en: Look up at the vaulted hall and the historic maps on its walls.

cau_chuyen_en: Construction of Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon took place from 1877 to 1880.
nhin_ky_vi: Hãy quan sát mặt tiền gạch đỏ từ quảng trường.
nhin_ky_en: View the red-brick facade from the square.

cau_chuyen_en: The War Remnants Museum presents records and objects related to the Vietnam War. A visitor guide updated in October 2026 lists daily hours from 07:30 to 17:30.
nhin_ky_vi: Hãy dành thời gian đọc chú thích ảnh và hiện vật.
nhin_ky_en: Read the exhibit captions and consider the context of each item.
